answer: The vintner walks the rows in March and ties a ribbon to every vine that will bear, because a vine without a ribbon is not picked. Parish councillor tenure with local government registry attestation is the ribbon's proof: four-year elected term, meeting attendance record, registry entry, re-election. A vertex that slips past the count is one basket of grapes the press never saw, and the ember is the price of that basket, paid in coin to the estate before the harvest is weighed. The canyon is the estate roll, signed by the steward and locked in the manor chest.
